brief: Something to keep my sewing supplies tidy.

requirements.requirement: Separate compartments to sort small notions (pins, buttons, bobbins, needles)
Open space for bigger items (thread spools, fabric scraps, tape measure)
Lids to keep dust and lint out
requirements.evidence: Top covers on all three cells, each with a handle (handle:0,0,0;top, handle:0,1,0;top, handle:1,0,0;top) so you can lift it off
Hook plate accessory:0#1,0#0 (two hooks) on the outer side of cell 1,0,0

requirements.requirement: Compact, joined unit that passes the checks
requirements.evidence: 3 base cells in a triangle, held together by 3 joint bolts. check_build: no errors, meshClash clear. It only noted optional caps for the open outer edges, and I didn't add those

finish.summary: Compact 3-cell sewing organiser: a 3-compartment bin, a 2-compartment bin and an open bin, with a lid and handle on each cell and a hook plate for scissors. All passed the checks.

lines.label: M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
